class.description: SplineTweener (`godot::Node`) SceneTree node that plays, loops, or scrubs a `SplineTweenResource` against a target `Node` or `MeshInstance3D` (driving blend shapes, properties, shader uniforms, and 3D offsets). Part of IdeamSplines (2D/3D Bezier/Catmull-Rom splines and scene-space spline editing).

members.member: Configures tween resource for this SplineTweener.
Configures target root path for this SplineTweener.
Configures process mode type for this SplineTweener (Idle:0,Physics:1,Manual:2).
Configures speed scale for this SplineTweener.
Configures current percent for this SplineTweener.

signal.description: Emitted when tween finished occurs on this SplineTweener.
